title: Caravan Pack Staging Court
description: One static caravan pack-staging courtyard for the original desert-oasis merchant-travel direction. A complete thick L-shaped mudbrick niche corner defines the rear-left edge; one complete empty twin-arch caravan pack frame sits in the front-left loading position. One whole tied cargo sack and one whole open amphora stand separately in a right-hand waiting-goods zone, leaving a continuous central separation band and a clear front transverse band. All four old models, complete original internals, holes, editable parts and per-face materials remain unchanged at unit scale; only rigid translations are used. One closed sandy court slab is scene-only. This is not the existing well/palm/canopy/bench water-drawing and shaded-rest corner with more plants or changed sand colour, not a forest stream recolour, and not a tricycle/platform delivery stop: it organizes an empty pack frame against a mudbrick backdrop with cargo kept off its still-empty ledges. No animals, people, rope harness, new cargo/container models, palm variants or additional model counts. One scene and zero new independent models. The niches remain empty and the original objects remain static; no demonstrated packing method, animal fit, water purity or supply, ceramic transport suitability, loading, building performance, accessibility, navigation or travel safety is asserted.
